subject: Pulse check: quota regression causing 429/retry spike
messages:
From: Evan Park <evan.park@mednova.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: support@mednova.com
Date: Fri, 10 Feb 2028 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Sudden spike: 429s and timeouts since this morning

Tessa,

We started seeing a flood of 429s around 08:50 PST across our integration. Latency is also elevated and our client SDKs are triggering aggressive retries which is amplifying the problem. Attached is a short sample of logs showing 429 responses for routine /v1/generate calls.

This is impacting our production workflows — can you route to engineering? We need triage ASAP.

Thanks,
Evan Park
Head of Integrations
MedNova Health

Attachment: mednova-429-sample-logs.txt (text)
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: Evan Park <evan.park@mednova.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Feb 2028 09:32:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden spike: 429s and timeouts since this morning

Hi Evan — thanks for the heads-up and the logs. I'm escalating to Ben and our SRE team. Initial questions while we triage:

- Is the traffic pattern steady or did you see a configuration change (deploy/service account) around 08:30–09:00?
- Can you share a HubSpot/Customer ID and any project labels you're using? We'll look for quota and tiering anomalies.

We will follow up with a quick triage update within 30 minutes.

—Tessa

Tessa Morgan
Senior AE, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, Evan Park <evan.park@mednova.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Feb 2028 09:45:03 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden spike: 429s and timeouts since this morning

Evan — I'm pulling mednova's call traces and quota mappings. Early signal: we have a recent quota-labeling migration that ran at 04:00 UTC (this morning) to start assigning org-level caps differently for projects that lacked explicit labels. I'm seeing a high rate of "project not found" on a subset of tokens which would cause fallback to a default project with much lower limits — likely the source of the sudden 429 amplification.

Immediate mitigations I'm pushing now:
- Temporarily whitelist mednova's customer token to bypass tier routing while we fix mappings (5m ETA).
- Increase project default cap by 3x for affected projects (5–10m ETA).
- Disable aggressive client-side retry suggestions in our SDK bulletin to avoid further retry storms.

I'll post back when changes are live.

Ben Carter
Director, SRE
Redwood Inference
Attachment: org-quota-snapshot-20280210.csv (csv)
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, Evan Park <evan.park@mednova.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Feb 2028 10:06:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden spike: 429s and timeouts since this morning

Update from infra: temporary whitelist applied at 09:50 PST; 429 rate dropped ~70% within ten minutes. We're still seeing intermittent latency elevations due to in-flight retries from MedNova services. Ben is rolling forward a permanent fix to the quota-label mapping (rollback + reapply labels with atomic verification). ETA for the permanent mapping fix: 2 hours. We'll monitor error budget and keep you posted.

Monica

Monica Patel
Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Evan Park <evan.park@mednova.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Feb 2028 12:21:37 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden spike: 429s and timeouts since this morning

Thanks for the quick action. Our side also pushed a short-term client update to back off retries (sliding backoff) to avoid re-amplifying the issue. Two notes:

1) We need a root cause write-up for our security/ops review (SOC/contract requirement).
2) Can Redwood provide a short-term credit for the 4 hours of degraded throughput while we were impacted? That will help the executive review while we wait for the post-mortem.

Evan
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: Evan Park <evan.park@mednova.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 11 Feb 2028 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden spike: 429s and timeouts since this morning

Evan — Appreciate your patience. Permanent fix applied at 12:00 PST and we've validated mapping correctness across MedNova projects; error rate has returned to baseline and latency is within SLO. Next steps:

- Ben will own a short RCA doc with timeline + technical root cause (quota-label migration edge-case) by EOD Monday. Link will be shared to your drive folder.
- Marissa (Account Lead) will open a credit request with Finance for the impacted window; we'll propose a pro-rated credit tied to the degraded token rate.
- We're updating our migration playbook to include atomic verification and a preflight that checks for unlabeled projects to prevent fallback to low-cap defaults.

I'll keep this thread open until the RCA and credit are finalized.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior AE, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
